description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home!* Approx. 120 ft. to Private Beach Access* Private Courtyard and Covered Patio * 2 Bikes Included * Waterfront Community Pool (Seasonally Heated November - March)* Walk to Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach* Professionally Managed, 24/7 serviceCome have the vacation of a lifetime when you stay at Sunset Serenade, a gorgeous 2 bed, 3 bath beach home in the highly coveted Sunset Beach Community on 30A. This quaint home has everything you need and is just steps away Seacrest Beach! The private courtyard and outdoor space area are the perfect spots to relax and enjoy those colorful Florida sunsets. The interior of the home has been tastefully decorated and features tile and wood floor throughout, and a kitchen complete with all stainless steel appliances and granite countertops. Upstairs you'll find the master and guest bedroom, each with a queen bed and access to a shared spacious balcony. The master bedroom also features a private balcony that overlooks the Gulf of Mexico. A short walk from the home is the sparkling, waterfront community pool with a stunning panorama view of the sugar white sands and emerald waters of the Gulf. You'll be right near all the fun of 30A but in a private beach community- it's the best of both worlds! Come make lifelong memories at Sunset Serenade and make this Villas of Sunset Beach home your family's vacation tradition for years to come!*There is currently ongoing construction in the adjacent neighborhood. Estimated completion Summer 2023.*The Villas at Sunset Beach is an intimate, gated gulf-front community situated between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, just across the street from the famous, oversized Seacrest Beach chair. The Villas at Sunset Beach sit directly on top of the beach dunes, overlooking the beautiful Gulf of Mexico. While the units at Sunset Beach offer privacy and exclusivity, the location offers all of the shopping and dining options you desire! The community is complete with a waterfront resort pool and private beach access to the white sands of the Emerald Coast!The Bed Setup:2nd Floor:Master Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole.This laid back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special!The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
